A Hive is made up of several layers of acidic wax layered over a mound of corpses. Once the barrier is established, Infernal Wasp eggs are planted that later hatch and feed upon the decomposed bodies inside. - Stalls incoming enemies 

- Spawns three wasps that orbit the demon, with each wasp attacking and stopping zombies that get close
- Wasps respawn a set time after they die, but when all wasps are dead, the Hive is defenseless


- Strong VS 
	- High Speed
	- High Numbers
	
- Weak VS 
	- High Health

Said to be inspired by the screams of his victims, the Maws are Argus’ most sinister creation. With an insatiable appetite, the chasmic throat of the beast appears to stretch endlessly into the depths of Syn’s core. - Can Insta-kill most enemies 

- Maintains 3 tentacles which consume zombies whole as they approach, killing them instantly
- When a zombie is eaten, a digestion timer starts, and when the timer is done, the tentacle is free to consume another zombie 

- Strong VS
	- High Health
	
- Weak VS 
	- High Numbers
	- High Speed
